decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application for the erection of a single storey rear extension to ground floor and rear extension on the first floor and erection of roof extension incorporating roof lights to existing flats, as shown on drawing numbers 2999/2B, received 5th January 2006, is recommended for approval as it is considered that the extension by reason of its size, materials and design would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of Number 31 Harvard Road, Chiswick. The extension would preserve the character of the Conservation Area and would not be detrimental to the surrounding properties. The development is in accordance with the London Borough of Hounslow's Unitary Development Plan (2003) and is compliant with Councils Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the North East or South West elevation of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the 3 flats at the address 31 Harvard Road, and the 3 flats hereby extended shall not be further subdivided.

Condition : 7 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to ground floor and rear extension on first floor and erection of roof extension incorporating roof lights to 3 existing flats .
